mechanism: Fit GJR-GARCH (variance + γ·I(ε<0)·ε²) or TARCH (conditional σ with absolute shocks, power=1) on scaled log returns over a sliding HistoryLen window each new bar; one-step forecast plotted as σ̂. Volatility z-score = (σ̂ − mean(conditional_vol_hist)) / std(conditional_vol_hist); flag abnormal spike when |z| > Num_Stds (e.g. 1.5–2.0). Prefer GJR for equity tail risk, TARCH for FX/outlier-robust forecasts.
data_needed: Close→log returns; HistoryLen (~200); GARCH p,o,q; mean model; ScaleFactor; Num_Stds threshold.

mechanism: On closed-bar fast/slow EMA cross, latch signal and freeze EMA slope (fCur−fPrev); generate FutureBars synthetic OHLC with step = signed_slope · 0.91^i plus ±15% wick noise. Invalidate if live close moves InvalidationPips against signal price; clear projection. Output is a decaying momentum path + invalidation event, not a price oracle.

mechanism: CZone wraps rectangles with type SUPPORT/RESISTANCE and status VIRGIN→BROKEN→INACTIVE. Height = 0.5·ATR. Resurrection if close re-enters before GhostBarLimit bars; else extinction. Merge same-type zones within MergeSensitivity·ATR; hybrid SyncHybridObjects adopts manual rectangles.
